name: Kirimiya Yuuto
source:
Shinonome-gumi's youngest yet also one of its longest-standing members.

Has natural charm that makes it easy for him to connect with anyone he meets. 
Even the residents of Tenkai District can’t help but greet him warmly whenever they see him.

Part of the Shinonome-gumi
